resources.string: Show a small, read-only EON card over other apps until you stop it or lock the screen. It takes no touches and reads no screen content. Android and other apps may hide it or reject touches under it; it is hidden on EON controls. Use the notification to check a model profile, meter a built-in tone (not live audio), or stop. No role or accessibility service is needed.

Optional live microphone: request Android permission first. A separate Start tap returns to your previous app and shows up to six seconds of local microphone levels on the card. No audio is saved or sent. Stop from the notification, reopen EON, or lock the screen.
